name: Bela
title: Edom's First King
summary: Bela, son of Beor, was the first king who reigned in Edom before any king ruled over Israel. He reigned in the city of Dinhabah. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the line of Edomite kings.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Edom's First King
keyEvents.description: Bela, son of Beor, is listed as the first king who reigned in the land of Edom before the Israelites had kings. He reigned in the city of Dinhabah.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Successor of Bela
keyEvents.description: When Bela died, Jobab, son of Zerah from Bozrah, became king in his place in Edom.

keyEvents.title: The List of Edomite Kings in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Bela is mentioned again in the repetition of the list of Edomite kings in Chronicles, confirming his role as the first king of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Edom's Lineage from Esau
keyEvents.description: Bela is part of the broader account of Esau's descendants who settled in the mountains of Seir and established the kingdom of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Kings of Edom before Israel
keyEvents.description: The Bible text emphasizes that these kings reigned in Edom "before any king reigned over the children of Israel," which places Bela in an early historical context.
